name: Mini Oásis: Summer Friendships Film
description: Escape the afternoon heat with a special family film screening of "O Garoto Cósmico" (The Cosmic Boy) as part of Batalha's summer program.
longDescription:
Mini Oásis: Summer Friendships Film is a special screening of the animated feature "O Garoto Cósmico" (The Cosmic Boy) presented by Batalha Centro de Cinema. This event is part of Batalha's broader summer programming, designed to offer cultural activities during the warmer months. The film, a Brazilian production from 2014 directed by Alê Abreu, tells the story of three children who embark on an adventure into space.

Visitors will experience a family-focused film screening in the air-conditioned comfort of Batalha Centro de Cinema, providing a respite from the afternoon heat. The film is suitable for a family audience, with a runtime of 79 minutes. The original language of the film is Portuguese. Batalha Centro de Cinema is a notable cultural institution in Porto, known for its focus on diverse cinematic programming.

Tickets for the screening vary in price. Batalha Centro de Cinema is located in central Porto, a short walk from Bolhão metro station. The venue is accessible by public transport and is within walking distance of many central Porto landmarks.
